caption: The video captures a woman with long dark hair dancing in a bright studio, seen from behind as she faces a mirror wall that reflects her front. She wears a black sleeveless top, a ruffled zebra-print skirt, black ankle wraps, and heeled sandals. She holds a pose with elbows bent and fists raised near her shoulders. Her arms open outward, one reaching toward the mirror while the other swings to her side. She rotates toward her left into a side-on profile, lifting and crossing her legs as the skirt flares. After a brief crossed-leg stance with arms lowered, she turns back toward the mirror and spreads both arms wide. The fists return to her chest, the arms open again, and she draws them in to cross her hands before extending one arm outward. The motion continues as her body angles once more.
